name: Butcher tableau sampler (user-defined explicit Runge-Kutta)
plain: An explicit Runge-Kutta step in sigma space whose a, b and c coefficients come from YAML; presets include euler, heun, midpoint, rk4, bosh3, rk3, kutta3, cash_karp, dopri5, fehlberg and radau3 (fractions may be written as '1/6'). Each stage evaluates the model at σ + c_i·h and uses the derivative (x−D)/σ; optional ancestral noise is added after the deterministic step to σ_down. A blend mode instead builds stages from denoised offsets and lerps by σ'/σ. Surprises: the final step to σ=0 returns the model's denoised unless step_to_zero is on, and the radau3 preset is run explicitly (its first stage evaluates the model on unchanged x but at σ + h/3), so it is not a real implicit Radau method.
math:
Symbols: h = σ_down − σ; k_i stage derivatives; D model denoised.
x_i = x + h·Σ_{j<i} a_ij k_j; σ_i = σ + c_i h; k_i = (x_i − D(x_i,σ_i))/max(σ_i,1e−5).
x' = x + h·Σ b_i k_i, then ancestral: x' ← x'·coef + σ_up·s_noise·ε (coef = (1−σ')/(1−σ_down) for flow).
Blend mode: x_i = lerp(x + Σ a_ij(D_j − x), x, σ'/σ); x' = lerp(x + Σ b_i(D_i − x), x, σ'/σ).

props.extra_model_calls: stages − 1 per step (len(c) model calls per step)
props.params: eta 0, s_noise 1, step_scale 1, first/last_ancestral_step 0/−1, first/last_blend_step 0/−1, blend_mode NO_BLEND, step_to_zero off, yaml_tableau (default euler)
